cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take me as your expedition photographer, not Martin. I taught you to frame a landscape; I can stop you cutting out the sponsor again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're crossing a desert. Martin knows how to photograph dunes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So do you, thanks to me. Your problem is keeping the people paying for the dunes happy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want their logo in every picture. Even the empty landscapes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put their flask in the foreground. You used to leave everything in shot; hire me and we'll finally make that habit useful.
